objective: Define one versioned observability contract for the Agent, Motion, MCU, World Model and Dashboard records: a correlation envelope of run, action, attempt, component, schema version and monotonic timestamp; a five-class failure taxonomy of timeout, rejection, transport loss, stale evidence and verification failure; an in-band bounded payload projection that reports what it dropped; a trace join over retries, frames, evidence references and the final verification verdict; and a rotating JSONL sink that redacts and stays parseable under concurrent writes.
decision_supported: Can an operator join a telemetry line to the run, action and attempt that produced it, count each distinct failure separately, and tell from the artifact itself whether it was bounded, redacted or left complete?
acceptance: a record carries run_id, component and schema_version always, and action_id, attempt_id and monotonic_ns when the caller has them
an attempt_id without an action_id is refused rather than written as an unjoinable retry
an unrecognized contract value raises instead of being classified as no failure, so a renamed status cannot silently stop being counted
timeout, rejection, transport loss, stale evidence and verification failure are counted as five separate classes with a documented precedence
trace_fields joins one correlation record to its attempts, retries, frame ids, evidence references and final verification verdict
bounded_payload cuts keys, list items, nesting depth and string length and reports every omission by path
the omission report travels in the artifact under a truncation key, so silent truncation is impossible
a payload that cannot be written as finite JSON raises instead of being written partially
failure counts are bounded in series count and attributable to the run that produced them
concurrent writers and rotation keep every JSONL line complete and parseable
the sink scrubs each record again at the write, so a caller that forgot to redact cannot leak by forgetting
raw prompts and camera bytes become reference markers while evidence references and hashes survive
only the identifiers the existing redactor freezes are copied verbatim; every new field is still scanned as untrusted text
the logger stays backward compatible for its existing callers
evidence: Task Packet schema validation output with exit code
targeted pytest output listing the collected Issue #76 test names, pass counts and exit codes
python3 -m pytest tests/unit -k logging output showing the logger tests are selected
mutation probe output: with the attempt-without-action refusal removed, the unjoinable-retry test fails
mutation probe output: with the omission report emptied, the bounded-payload tests fail
mutation probe output: with the sink redaction removed, the forgot-to-redact test fails
mutation probe output: with redaction moved after measuring, the raw-evidence test fails
mutation probe output: with the truncation marker removed, the bounded-sink-record test fails
mutation probe output: with the transport-loss precedence removed, the precedence test fails
mutation probe output: with the unknown-value rejection removed, the classification test fails
mutation probe output: with the counter run attribution broken, the attribution tests fail
a concurrent-writer run showing no lost, duplicated or interleaved line
make test, make contract, make scenario-check, make golden-check, make context-check and make docs output with exit codes
final git diff --check and git diff --name-only output proving every changed path is allowed
stop_conditions: Meeting the acceptance requires editing libs/contracts, an interface schema, robot control, firmware or a path owned by another module.
The contract would let a record be written without a run, component or schema version.
An unrecognized contract value is classified as success instead of raising.
Truncation becomes silent, or a record is written that cannot be parsed back.
The sink writes a record without scrubbing it, or a credential, raw prompt or camera byte reaches a file.
Counting becomes unbounded, or the taxonomy collapses two distinct failures into one class.
data_classification: internal; tests use synthetic identifiers, synthetic credential-shaped values assembled from fragments, and synthetic byte payloads, and read no real robot, camera or credential data
model_policy: no model call; classification, projection, counting and rotation are deterministic
